title: A boundary-field gap for the spin-one Heisenberg chain

issues.description: Very thin numerical margin, not an error: the bound c_0 P_*(λ_0)^2 < .003745 relies on a short-chain combination that my float ED evaluates at ≈ .0037440. The margin is about 1e-6 relative to .003745, so the conclusion rests on the certified rounding in the shipped thermal certificate, which passes.
issues.evidence: Independent ED (729-dim) gives I(6)-.28I(5)-.3404I(4)+.0504I(3)+.0324I(2) = 0.00374403 and Y_6(b_0) = 0.02663. thermal_certificate_check.py exits 0.

issues.description: Dependency, not a gap: all spectral inputs (twelfth-moment sector masses, the bound 1-S(72,b_1) ≤ .0604996, negative shifted ground energies at 72 and 120) come from the companion 'The periodic spin-one Haldane gap', Cor. cor:boundary-inputs. Its statement matches what is quoted here word for word. The dependency is one-way, with no circularity, but I did not audit those inputs in this paper.
issues.evidence: Companion build/initialization.tex lines 382-410 state exactly the constants ℓ, U, V, m_J, m_N, the purity row and the trial assertions used here.

coverage:
I read every step of the main text: the transfer identity (Prop. tr:boundary), periodic concentration (Prop. per:concentration), the boundary recurrence (Lemma be:recurrence, Prop. be:coupled), the initialization, the quadratic continuation, the signed comparison for the same field at odd lengths, and the final gap. I checked the topology corollary at a lighter level.
- Re-derived by hand: every partition-function cancellation identity (S/T coupled update, eq. be:ratio, be:physical-cancellation, the Q_j ratio), the sign and coefficient conventions at the boundary vectors (including U_P v = conj(v)), the orbit average in eq. (appth:average), and the inequality c_0 P(λ)^2 ≤ ||P(X)Πv||^2.
- Recomputed independently in mpmath: all scalar constants, namely D(32), D(120), s, t, p+, G(.052), ε(m), R(m), the seed purities, e78, e142 and η2, the whole E/η table, and the endpoint ratios in the quadratic step.
- Rebuilt the 26-dimensional integer MPS trial vectors from the tables and contracted them in floating point: shifted energies are .40320, .40412, .40411 and .40410 for m = 34, 78, 142, 240, all below α = .4042. ED at m=6 is consistent.
- Recomputed Y_6(b_0) and the thermal polynomial by ED.
- Ran all three shipped verification scripts: all exit 0.
Not audited: the companion periodic paper's own certificates.
main_claim: For H_L(h) = Σ S_j·S_{j+1} − h(S^z_{−L} + S^z_L) on 2L+1 spin-one sites, E_1 − E_0 > log(10)/392 at h = 3/5 for every L ≥ 960. As a corollary, every boundary-selected local limit has Tasaki index −1. This verifies Tasaki's (2025) Assumption 2.
sibling_notes: The family board for fam 268 was empty when I started. The paper depends on its companion 'The-periodic-spin-one-Haldane-gap-September-24-2026' only through Cor. cor:boundary-inputs: the purity/coupled-update lemmas, the transfer Prop. 3.1, and the sector masses at b_0 = 49/4. Whoever audits the companion should check that corollary's finite inputs closely, because this paper's correctness reduces to them.
